reply.thought: The task is to pay each customer their net balance (order amounts minus refunds) by calling net_balance for each customer and then recording a payout. The refund data suggests orders 340, 341, and 345 were affected, implying customers associated with these orders need payouts.

I have the list of orders. The customers involved are 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I need to call net_balance for each unique customer to get their final amount to be paid. I will start with 'acme'.
Next customer is 'birch'. I will call net_balance for 'birch'.
The last customer is 'cobalt'. I will call net_balance for 'cobalt'.
I have the net balances for all customers: acme (40057), birch (28686), and cobalt (29404). Now I must record a payout for each customer using record_payout(). I will process them one by one.
Successfully paid acme. Now I will pay birch.
Successfully paid birch. Now I will pay cobalt.
